description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores for five different models: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS. The horizontal axis displays the model names in an unspecified order, with labels reading from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Five individual bars are present, each corresponding to a model. The “Standard” model is represented by a light gray bar extending to approximately 42. The “Self-RAG” model is represented by a light green bar extending to approximately 44. The “FactTune” model is represented by a yellow-green bar extending to approximately 46. The “ClnGS (w/)" model is represented by a green bar extending to approximately 52. Finally, the “ClnGS” model is represented by a blue bar extending to approximately 58. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no grouping or stacking of bars.
